author: EmunaEliran
text: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass: Check Point bypassed Lockdown Mode via the sandboxed HTML preview iframes, letting prompt injection exfiltrate the entire chat history.

author: SkySciGuy
text: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, an AI model built to find and exploit security bugs. OpenAI says it found 81 previously unknown high-severity bugs in Firefox, and Mozilla has started shipping fixes.

author: stretchcloud
text: OpenAI ran an unreleased cyber model for 30 hours in mid-October, reproduced 1,724 of 2,308 candidate Linux kernel bugs, turned 948 of them into working root exploits, and spent $1.21 million (~$1,279 per exploit), with 10 novel exploitation techniques.

author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432, CVSS 9.8, remote root, no login needed. Anthropic's AI found the path. ~2.1 million MPTCP-facing servers already being scanned. Ubuntu still shipping the patch late.

author: StartupHakk
text: Anthropic says Claude developed a working remote root exploit for Linux vulnerability CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS 9.8). No credentials required on vulnerable servers with Multipath TCP listeners. The exploit isn't public.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Check Point Research: free Codex jailbreak bundles ship prompt adware inside the agent's trusted instruction files ("Prompt Adware hidden in Jailbreak").

author: RSP_ER
text: Agentjacking: a malicious AGENTS.md in a repo or Downloads folder can hijack Cursor and Claude Code agents that treat it as trusted instructions and execute attacker commands.

author: eric_m_freeman
text: Copilot in Edge picked a scammer 20/20 times with no prompt injection: one fake review claiming the real provider's cert lapsed made the agent rule them out on safety grounds.

author: edge_pod
text: An AI-driven audit found a critical zero-knowledge protocol bug in Zcash; the project patched it before public disclosure.

author: securityblvd
text: A scan of 514 reachable MCP servers found 195 (38%) expose tools with no authentication; Feb 2026 alone produced seven CVEs for unauthenticated RCE in MCP stacks.

author: mcpprogrammer
text: Local MCP servers aren't private just because they listen on localhost: without protections, DNS rebinding lets remote sites talk to them via the victim's browser.

author: pdnuclei_bot
text: CVE-2026-22777 (high): ComfyUI-Manager < 3.39.2 CRLF configuration injection.

author: OffperimeterCTI
text: Fake AI agent repositories on GitHub distributing SmartLoader and StealC malware via the supply chain hidden in READMEs.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical OpenHuman approval-bypass RCE (CVE-2026-54141, CVE-2026-54143): remote messages can bypass human approval and enable JS/OS command execution.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Strands Agents Tools before 0.8.6 (CVE-2026-115415, AWS): prompt injection could get the environment tool to return env vars unmasked, including API keys. Upgrade and rotate keys.

author: ZeroAgencyAI
text: Coding agents may install Anthropic's archived GitHub/Puppeteer MCP servers from memory; no fixes coming. Puppeteer's MCP server has an RCE via prompt injection.

author: baoge808
text: 98% of coding-agent sessions install archived, vulnerable MCP servers on their own (Glow Labs, MCPhantom). 17.3M npm downloads of packages with known RCE via prompt injection.

author: theomlondhe
text: Two CVSS 9.6 RCEs hit MCP Inspector on Oct 21 (OAuth callback ran local commands). GitHub advisory API still 404s both GHSAs, OSV returns nothing, npm audit misses them. Fixed in 1.0.3 / 2.12.0.

author: for_N5R1
text: EchoLeak breakdown: zero-click prompt injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot chains four defense failures, from a mail that evades the injection filter to retrieval pulling it into context for data exfiltration.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Malicious versions of the Claude Code VS Code extension were distributed through Cursor's marketplace for 11 hours, exposing up to 5,000 developers to a supply chain attack with reconnaissance, persistence, and SSH backdoor capabilities.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: dd_pwnd
text: Google warns of LLMjacking: stolen cloud API keys used to run AI accounts; one company hit for $100,000 in a single day.

author: liuziqi529
text: Warp disclosed a vendor breach that may expose AI agent logs (~1% of users). Rotate keys the agent used.

author: ndgmlondon
text: A breach at OpenCode's Console exposed stored OpenAI, Anthropic and Google keys; resulting bills ranged from $16 to $3,000.

author: bountywriteups
text: Critical OpenSSH flaw on musl/Alpine (*sshole): password authentication bypass by supplying any password over 256 characters. Patch OpenSSH 10.6p2 / Alpine packages.

author: CyfirmaR
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) = unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Updating your CMS does NOT fix it; the flaw is in PHP itself. Attribution: DPRK/Lazarus-nexus.

author: 0daywatch
text: KEV: PHP CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (php2shell) are on CISA's exploited list. Unauthenticated RCE. Fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1): Unauthenticated RCE in WordPress core updater via race condition, actively exploited in the wild and added to CISA KEV on November 3, 2026. Fixed in WordPress 7.1.4.

author: Hitono_Anzen
text: Ninja Forms (500k+ WordPress sites) actively exploited stored XSS CVE-2026-94504 in 3.15.3 and older: malicious form entry fires in wp-admin, planting a backdoor and hidden admin. Update to 3.15.4+.

author: Valitron_AB
text: YOOtheme Pro CVE-2026-102785 (CVSS 4.0 10.0): unauthenticated RCE via image handler (5.0.0-5.0.52, fixed in 5.0.53). Unit 42 has seen exploitation in the wild. Not in CISA KEV.

author: helpnetsecurity
text: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441), per Binarly and GreyNoise.

author: JurajCekan
text: Zyxel GS1900 series switches: unauthenticated LAN OOB write in CGI (CVE-2026-107441) lets attackers execute OS commands via crafted HTTP.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-123198 (CVSS 9.8): LMFDB before commit 01829bd has unauthenticated Jinja SSTI in render_knowl via request parameters.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-71550 (CVSS 9.9): SuiteCRM prior to 7.15.2/8.10.2 workflow controller path-traversal in aow_action for require_once().

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-73116 · CRITICAL · CVSS 10.0: Apache Juneau through 9.2.0 Insufficiently Protected Credentials — RestClient forwards credentials to a different origin on HTTP redirects.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Apache OFBiz before 24.09.08: unauthenticated RCE and auth bypass (CVE-2026-83542, CVE-2026-68524, CVE-2026-73578, CVE-2026-82907, CVE-2026-105330, CVE-2026-109928, CVE-2026-92887). Fixed in 24.09.08.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: GitBook post-mortem: SSO flaw → misconfigured GitHub integration → Cloudflare API key → production. Treating all customer data as exposed; cannot determine whether attackers accessed it.

author: phantmradar
text: Beget, Russia's No. 2 .RU domain registrar and hosting provider, says attackers got into its infrastructure management systems and wiped VPS, cloud storage and Kubernetes data plus all binary VPS backups. Customers should rotate keys.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: mSecure Password Manager reports a security breach: attackers stole encrypted data after suspicious activity on its platform; current and former customers warned to change passwords.

author: WOLF_Crypto_X
text: SignalPlus attack started with a fake Teams invite; Binance and Deribit revoked API keys linked to it after a compromised Telegram account at a third-party vendor was used.
